decisions.reason: As the flagship premium stollen and recent gold medal winner, it is very unlikely to be discontinued.
This seeded rye bread fits the firm's traditional portfolio and showed normal presentation, so it is likely retained.
The dark barley malt rye bread complements existing products and had no negative signals, suggesting it stays.
Although a seasonal item, marzipan stollen is close to established holiday offerings and still likely to be kept.
The ancient grain bread was actively promoted as a new specialty and aligns with traditional craft baking, so it is likely retained.
